desc: Ideation: reduce the problem to maximizing the common sum H; identify the O(N) shortest-path/distance-transform formula and an O(N log C) binary-search fallback.

Implement the O(N) direct formula solution: read all input, compute total, compute f_i = min_j(U_j + X*|i-j|) with two passes, set H = min_i(D_i + f_i), print total - N*H; verified on all provided samples.
